text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That is NOT Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep it down. ...But I agree with 
that opinion.

The day after Acting Principal Kashimoto 
took office. The gymnasium was filled with 
loud boos from the students.

—The time was one hour ago. A gathering 
was being held for Acting Director 
Kashimoto as a welcoming gesture.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And now, we will hear a greeting from 
Acting Director Kashimoto, who has taken 
up her post as the representative of the 
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—Nice to meet you all. I am Kashimoto, 
appointed as of yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I have been entrusted with running this 
academy for a while on Chairwoman 
Akikawa's behalf. It is a pleasure to meet 
you all.
(Clap clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what I felt upon visiting this 
academy was—an irredeemable 'slackness.'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: L-Looseness...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
For instance: permitting self-directed 
training, a lack of punctuality for start 
times, and allowing idle chatter during 
breaks.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, the utter lack of 
coordination between the Umamusume and 
Trainer, not even keeping track of sleep 
habits.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Rather than the fault of the students, 
this stems from negligence on the part of 
the Trainers and the leniency of 
Chairwoman Akikawa. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Here and now, I present a training policy 
based on strict authoritarian control: the 
"Managed Education Program."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
First, thorough management from training 
regimen to diet, and eventually even her 
private life—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Through this, we aim to further enhance 
talent while lowering the risk of injury.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whaaa~...? Hey, Rice-chan, what do you 
mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Does that mean... I won't be able to 
eat ice cream in the middle of the night 
anymore...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The recently revived inter-team 
tournament, the Aoharu Cup, will also be 
abolished shortly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? Why is that!?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Adolescent students with heightened 
sensitivities can make reckless, emotional 
decisions the stronger the bonds they form 
within a team.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"To prevent teams from running wild in 
this manner, we are abolishing team 
races."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No one will go out of control on a team, 
no sir! As long as teammates support one 
another—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Let's say, for example, that every member 
of a certain team was engaging in 
excessive extra training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Their only desire is to win. There's no 
malice in it—they're just giving it their 
all as one.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However—eventually, one reached her 
physical limit... and could no longer run.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Things I could have paced myself on when 
running alone got out of hand in a team 
setting because I got caught up in the 
excitement and pushed too hard.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If this isn't running wild, I don't know 
what to call it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's... weeeell...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To prevent such things from happening, we 
will abolish the team system and enforce 
the most thorough management possible.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: —That is all.

Acting Principal Kashimoto's 
uncompromising tone brought total silence 
to the entire gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As soon as preparations are complete, we 
will enforce the "Supervised Education 
Program." Everyone, brace yourselves.

The meeting, which was supposed to have 
started on a cheerful note, ended in utter 
chaos—

Acting Principal Kashimoto's strict 
management regime was about to begin...!
